caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental corner bracket design labeled "IRON LACE WORK." The design consists of intricate, repeating patterns of grapevines, leaves, and bunches of grapes arranged within curved, crisscrossing lines. The motif appears both horizontally and vertically, comprising the edges and diagonals of a triangular bracket shape. The drawing is rendered in sepia-toned ink on a cream-colored background. There are three primary views: a side elevation, a horizontal elevation, and a diagonal perspective of the bracket as it fits beneath a ledge or shelf. Notable linear measurements are indicated, including "40 inches" for the horizontal span, "45 inches" for the vertical height, "49 1/4 inches" for the diagonal length, and "10 inches" for the bottom base. A shaded rectangular box in the bottom right contains the text “IRON LACE WORK.” The composition is largely composed of closely arranged grape clusters, broad veined leaves, and curling vine tendrils, all framed by straight edges in a stylized, interlacing manner.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
